request.style: English, male solo voice with full choir, harp, strings, piano, timpani, majestic and reverent mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
With awesome deeds of righteousness you answer us
O God of our salvation, the hope of all
You set the mountains in place by your strength
Girded with might, you hold the earth in place

[Chorus]
You care for the land and water it
You enrich it abundantly, yes you do
The streams of God are filled with water
To provide the people with grain

[Verse]
You drench its furrows and level its ridges
You soften it with showers and bless its growth
You crown the year with your bounty
And your paths overflow with abundance

[Chorus]
You care for the land and water it
You enrich it abundantly, yes you do
The streams of God are filled with water
To provide the people with grain

[Bridge]
The pastures of the wilderness overflow
The hills are robed with joy, they sing
The meadows are clothed with flocks
And the valleys are mantled with grain

[Chorus]
You care for the land and water it
You enrich it abundantly, yes you do
The streams of God are filled with water
To provide the people with grain

[Outro]
They shout for joy, they break into song
The hope of all the ends of the earth
